messages.subject: Help info does not display
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I just installed RkWard for Windows. 

 Help does not want to appear neither from a script file (Function reference) nor from the Help Search window at the bottom of RKWard and nor from Help on R in the Help menu.

For example, I tried to get help for persp() function, but no help is displayed.

I used the Windows installer to install RKWard:
   
   - RKWard Version 0.7.0b
   - R 3.4.4
   - Windows 10

Thanks,

François

messages.subject: Help info does not display
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

On Thu, 1 Aug 2019 09:11:01 +0000 (UTC)
Francois Maurice <maurice.francois at ymail.com> wrote:
> I just installed RkWard for Windows. 
> 
>  Help does not want to appear neither from a script file (Function
> reference) nor from the Help Search window at the bottom of RKWard
> and nor from Help on R in the Help menu.
> 
> For example, I tried to get help for persp() function, but no help is
> displayed.

could you try running
  rk.show.html("some_local_file.html")
? Does this work?

What is the output of
  options("browser")
? (Try setting it to
  options(browser=rk.show.html)
)

Does the "Help on RKWard" from the Help menu display, correctly?

Regards
Thomas

On Fri, 2 Aug 2019 10:31:11 +0000 (UTC)
Francois Maurice <maurice.francois at ymail.com> wrote:
>  This one works perfectly :  rk.show.html("some_local_file.html")

Good. Does the following work, too:
  browseURL("some_local_file.html")

> Here is the ouput of options("browser"):
[...]

Looks good. My next guess is that it might be options("help_type").
Could you make sure this is set to "html"?

Thanks
Thomas
